public.title: Minimum Window Substring
public.description: Return the shortest contiguous substring of text containing every character of required with its multiplicity. Break equal-length ties by earliest start. Return an empty string if impossible or required is empty. Both strings contain only ASCII letters; text length is 0 to 1000 and required length is 0 to 100.
hints: Maintain required-character deficits in a sliding window.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Extend until every occurrence is covered, then shrink while still valid. Each boundary moves forward at most n times. O(n plus required length) time.
